historical_environment.limitation: The paper's IPOPT 3.13.2 executable and original host platform were not recovered. The exact surviving IDAES commit and Pyomo version were recovered and installed from a clean declarative environment.

pr_gate.basis: All 22 published figures and tables have an explicit evidence-backed disposition. Every quantitative artifact has a deterministic archive replay; every surviving optimization case was attempted on the documented notebook path, and nonreproducing cases have solver/scaling diagnostics and controls.
does_not_claim: recovery of unpublished source artwork for Figures 1 and 2
exact reproduction of EF-2 or EF-11 fresh optimization
the archived EF-8 point is the best local optimum
the paper and public repository contain the same emissions normalization or optimization snapshot

items.assessment: The process schematic is publication artwork, not a computed result. Its units and connectivity were reviewed against create_flowsheet/define_arcs; no editable artwork source exists in the public repository.

The multiscale workflow schematic is publication artwork. Its sequence was reviewed against the surviving initialization, costing, optimization, and postprocessing notebooks; no editable artwork source exists publicly.
Checkpoint replay reproduces the archived bars; all four ROK solves reproduce the surviving numerical snapshot. Article labels retain EMISSIONS-NORMALIZATION-001.
The M5/Bakken optimal composite curve is deterministically regenerated, and its underlying fresh ROK solve reproduces the archived state.

The archived curve is regenerated. Six tax cases reproduce directly; the 190-to-410 jump fails with MA27 and MA57, while the archived 410 optimum is stable and smaller continuation steps find a distinct lower local optimum.

The complete archived regional series is regenerated. Nine of 13 fresh regional notebook-path cases closely reproduce; EF-8 and EF-10 move to alternate states, and EF-2/EF-11 fail under both HSL solvers. Article labels also retain EMISSIONS-NORMALIZATION-001.
All archived component stacks are regenerated. Fresh regional exceptions are documented; EF-7 and EF-10 printed totals also demonstrate PUBLISHED-SNAPSHOT-DRIFT-001.
The complete archived MSP/methane scatter is regenerated from checked-in inputs. Fresh regional exceptions are shared with Figures 6-7 and Table S6.
All four checkpoint component stacks regenerate, and all four ROK fresh solves reproduce the surviving snapshot.
All four C4+ olefin percentages regenerate within 0.002253 percentage point of the printed labels.
All M2-M4 archived composite curves regenerate; the corresponding fresh ROK solves reproduce the archived states.
All seven archived carbon-tax composite curves regenerate. The 410 USD/tonne fresh transition has the local-solution behavior recorded for Figure 5.
The regional feed-composition plot regenerates directly from data/Shale_composition.csv.
All EF-1 through EF-6 archived curves regenerate. EF-2 is the only fresh exact-path failure in this panel; its MA27/MA57 and checkpoint-control diagnostics are recorded.
All EF-7 through EF-12 archived curves regenerate. EF-8/EF-10 alternate states and the EF-11 exact-path failure are fully recorded.
The EF-Basin archived curve regenerates and the fresh solve closely reproduces its detailed state.
Seven bounds/relations match. The printed H104 range is 295-500 K, but the reconstructed model retains 273.15-1500 K because the optimization update never applies the printed bounds.
Seven parameters match directly, the two cooling prices are split between optimization and publication postprocessing, and methane recovery/GWP lack a semantic public source.
All 14 regional upstream factors match the checked-in CSV within print-rounding tolerance.
All four ROK cases reproduce the migrated snapshot at high precision. The paper table retains emissions-normalization and small publication-snapshot differences.
Six of seven tax cases reproduce directly. The archived 410 point is a stable local optimum; the direct notebook jump fails, and a finer continuation finds a different valid optimum.
Nine of 13 regional cases closely reproduce. EF-2 and EF-11 do not yield accepted exact-path solutions under MA27 or MA57; EF-8 and EF-10 reach different stationary states.
